column1: # Ash Jenna glimpsed in the Lamakan Desert after Mercury Lighthouse is lit.

column3: You look at every face\nas though the missing\nmight come back to you.{page_break}I did that once, too.{end_wait}
You look like Jenna.\nBut that can't be...\nWho are you?{end_wait}
I thought I could save\nthem if I kept moving.{page_break}I was too late.{end_wait}
Keep following them.\nThen ask what the\nbeacons are worth.{end_wait}
That's her face.\nBut it wasn't her voice.\nWho was she?{end_wait}
